images.seen: An estate street at dusk swallowed by fog, one pair of red tail lights glowing deep in the mist, a single streetlight overhead. Thursday.
lines: Those brake lights are the only warm colour left in the neighbourhood.
The fog swallowed the whole street and left the tail lights as a receipt.
Home is two hundred metres away and completely theoretical right now.

images.seen: A woman walking a labradoodle along a foggy seafront promenade at dusk, a curve of haloed streetlamps fading into the mist. Tuesday.
lines: Every streetlamp gets its own halo tonight; the fog is generous like that.
The sea is somewhere just off to the right; you'll have to take it on hearsay.
The dog knows this route with its nose, which tonight is the better instrument.

images.seen: Two friends taking a smiling selfie at a lookout whose view is a wall of white fog, the sign beside them blanked out by mist. Sunday.
lines: The viewpoint is performing at zero percent and the selfie is happening anyway.
Somewhere behind all that white is a famous view. Allegedly.
The fog got to the lookout first and took the whole view for itself.

images.seen: An aerial view of Cape Town at night with fog rolling through the CBD, the city lights glowing amber through the mist, Table Mountain black above it all. Wednesday.
lines: Cape Town is still on under there; the fog is just running interference.
The sea mist came in for the night and the whole city went soft.
Table Mountain kept its head out; the city took the blanket.
